notes.title: 🔧 New Update — Now in Beta!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve prepared some important improvements and uploaded them to beta branches so we can test them together. You can help us out and be among the first to try the changes:

✅ What’s New in This Beta:

– Reworked truck physics: improved grip, reduced excessive sliding, better trailer behavior

🚀 How to Access the Beta:

[olist]
[*] Open Steam and right-click on the game in your Library
[*]     Select Properties → go to the Betas tab
[*]     Enter the appropriate private beta access code [h3]TWAFHpatchpreview[/h3]
[*]     Choose the corresponding beta branch from the dropdown list
[/olist]

After testing, don’t forget to switch back to the main branch to receive future updates!
